desc: 玫瑰幕布理石展台，讲蝴蝶曲面与快拆插扣机制的牵引绳详情长图
leaf: 双面透气蝴蝶曲面胸背式宠物牵引绳（加厚编织绳身+快拆插扣，犬猫通用）
name: 蝴蝶曲面双面透气牵引绳款

shots.intent: 首屏用玫瑰纱幕与白理石立台把牵引绳整条挂出，一秒确立品类、形态与整套色系。
shots.textZone: 左上 kicker 一行，其下两行主标题位，再下一行三词短副标题位，右下一枚黄铜细线圆环标记

shots.intent: 白底副图承担主图一秒法则，只留一句核心主张与产品本体。
shots.textZone: 底部一行主张位，仅此一行，无其它文字

shots.intent: 把细绳受力时的局部压强与宽软垫的贴合状态并置，放大遛行拉扯的真实顾虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中主标题位，两栏下方各一行短标签位

shots.intent: 正俯视把前胸软垫的蝴蝶曲面轮廓描出来，让版型主张变成看得见的形状。
shots.textZone: 左下主标题位与两行引线短标签位，引线端点落在曲面边缘

shots.intent: 微距把双面透气面层与加厚垫层的真实质感做实，用可见做工替代口头承诺。
shots.textZone: 右上两行短标签位，配 hairline 细线

shots.intent: 两枚编号圆点把用料与做工两条主张分栏交代，回答它凭什么耐用好用。
shots.textZone: 卡外顶部主标题位（#FFFFFF），卡内两行编号标题与两行短说明位（#4B2A31）

shots.intent: 两格步骤把快拆插扣的一拉一扣讲清，消除买回去不会用的疑虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中主标题位，两枚圆框下方各一行编号短标签位

shots.intent: 四格同尺幅的适用对象矩阵替买家完成对号入座，减少尺码追问流失。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中主标题位（#FFFFFF），四格下方各一枚适用对象短标签位

shots.intent: 回到真实遛行情境，让人代入自家宠物出门那一刻的松弛感。
shots.textZone: 左上一行短副标题位，其余留白不叠字

shots.intent: 用五金、走线与绳结三个真实近景承担信任，绝不引入证书与检测号。
shots.textZone: 三格下方各一行短标签位，卡外顶部一行 kicker 位

shots.intent: 收口用低角度近景与一枚按钮位，把安全感主张转成下单动作。
shots.textZone: 上半区主标题位（#FFFFFF）与一行副标题位，右下圆角按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: matte draped-fabric panels, deep rose #A9525C paired with pale blush #F0CDC9, used as a two-tone vertical split across the mechanism and transition screens; product stands sit on white marble blocks #F1EDE7 with soft grey veining #C7C1B8 wrapped by one brushed-brass band #B8894C; infographic screens lay on ivory cards #F7F2EC with 24px corners over the rose panel; one benefit hero runs on seamless white #FFFFFF
style.direction: premium rose-and-marble studio pet walking-gear detail page
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline outlines in brushed brass #B8894C only: numbered open circles, dashed-circle step wells, rounded marble-framed product windows, hairline rules and the recurring triple-wave line motif in #A9525C; no filled chips, no 3D orbs, no cartoon mascots, no flat icon sprites
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused key from the upper right at 5400K with a large bounce fill from the left, low contrast, gentle falloff, one controlled specular that travels only along the brass band and the metal clip, soft contact shadows that always meet the marble top; macro and weave screens add one raking accent from the left; outdoor screens use natural morning sun at 5000K from frame left with one readable soft shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium rose-and-marble pet walking-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of deep rose drape panel #A9525C, pale blush drape panel #F0CDC9, white marble plane #F1EDE7 with soft grey veining #C7C1B8, one brushed-brass line accent #B8894C, ivory card ground #F7F2EC and deep plum type #4B2A31; warm tone; one-family modern geometric sans-serif with a wide letter-spaced latin kicker line above a two-line Chinese headline; background system of matte draped-fabric rose and blush panels used as a two-tone vertical split, white marble block podiums wrapped by one brushed-brass band, and rounded marble-framed product windows; soft diffused key from the upper right at 5400K with bounce fill from the left, low contrast, one controlled specular travelling only along the brass band and the metal clip, soft contact shadows that always meet the marble top, natural morning sun at 5000K from frame left in outdoor screens; layout system of two-tone split panels, ivory cards with 24px corners, hairline-outlined numbered circles, dashed-circle step wells, one hairline rule and the recurring triple-wave line motif; icon system of single-weight brushed-brass hairline outlines and the triple-wave motif only, no filled chips and no 3D illustration; the traction rope held at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale with its padded double-sided face, plaited rope body and quick-release clip always visible and never altered; any animal appears cropped above the shoulders or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no marble veining repeated as a pattern, no QR codes or membership corner stickers.
noDrift: no marble veining duplicated as a repeating pattern
no real rope length, girth, weight, load or size figures, no breed names, no certification or test marks unless supplied at generation time
no QR code, membership or store corner sticker
style.presentationRules: the traction rope keeps the same slight 3/4 hero geometry, scale and centring across the set; the padded double-sided face, the plaited thick rope body and the quick-release clip stay visible and never gain or lose a part; rope coils read as one continuous strand with correct perspective; metal reads as brushed brass not mirror gold; every animal is cropped above the shoulders or turned away so no individual identity reads; product always grounded by a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: white marble slab #F1EDE7 with veining #C7C1B8, matte deep-rose cylinder podium #A9525C, brushed brass band #B8894C, pale blush drape #F0CDC9 as ground plane, outdoor pale stone pavement #D8D2CB with a low grass edge #8A9678 kept out of focus
style.typography: one-family modern geometric sans-serif; wide letter-spaced latin kicker line above a two-line Chinese headline; Chinese headline 28-42pt, sub-line 16-20pt, label 14-16pt; headline in #4B2A31 on blush, ivory and marble, in #FFFFFF on the deep rose panel; every rendered line is a placeholder wrapped in 「」, never a real slogan
